advantages.a1: 30 coins after every successful monthly Premium payment.
advantages.a2: Premium Command Center with Command Summary, Race Strategy Lab and Season Planner.
advantages.a3: Transfer Command with saved searches, market alerts, deeper transfer analysis and unlimited coin-free shortlist additions within the active-list limit.
advantages.a4: Financial Simulator and Sponsor Intelligence for non-destructive planning and objective tracking.
advantages.a5: Rider Development Lab with development trends, prospect watch and advanced squad analysis.
advantages.a6: Templates, saved workflows and Smart Prefill automation that you review before saving.
advantages.a7: Unlimited world-race replays included without the normal 2-coin replay charge.
advantages.a8: Exclusive Developing Team access plus the U23 Head Coach: 100 coins to activate and 100 coins per season to renew.
advantages.a9: Exclusive Youth Academy: 16 U16 places, six local starter riders, Youth Academy Director, U16 Head Coach, scouting, racing, budget, equipment, infrastructure effects and graduation pathways.
advantages.a10: Premium improves information, planning and convenience only — it never increases race-engine strength, transfer acceptance or hidden rider skills.

comparison.title: Gratuit vs Premium
comparison.description: Free includes the complete core cycling-management game. Premium adds advanced planning and analysis plus the exclusive Developing Team, U23 Head Coach and Youth Academy.
comparison.r2: Race and compete in the full core game
comparison.r3: Core training, transfers, finance, equipment and infrastructure
comparison.r4: Manual management and normal gameplay without a Premium subscription
comparison.r5: Optional coin-funded services and Staff Briefing Centre access
comparison.note: Free conserve tout le jeu principal et le contrôle manuel. Developing Team se débloque après 30 jours réels OU 60 jours de jeu, coûte 100 coins à l'activation et 100 par saison. L'Académie Jeunes utilise la même règle 30/60, coûte 50 coins une seule fois et n'a pas de renouvellement saisonnier en coins ; elle utilise ensuite l'argent normal du club.
comparison.r11: Advanced planning, simulation and analytics tools
